items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: And Woody Herman, whom I went to after Charlie, was the same way -- and that was 1942, '43 and '44.

ctx.x: And this was where you began to develop ...

And Woody Herman, whom I went to after Charlie, was the same way -- and that was 1942, '43 and '44. He was the same way, just play -- I hired you because I want you, I want your drumming, and I developed a little more -- little by little, working with great musicians, and I've got some of Duke's now in the band, some record dates, and I suggested that.
